verdict.rationale: Shopify documents a first-party GraphiQL explorer, an in-browser tool for writing, validating, and executing queries and mutations against the Admin GraphQL API. It also publishes API reference docs for the Admin and Storefront APIs, so interactive exploration with runnable queries is directly supported. However, the evidence does not show runnable examples embedded in the reference pages, and the explorer is only evidenced for the Admin API. Missing for 10: evidence of runnable examples inside the API reference itself, interactive exploration for the Storefront and other APIs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: GraphiQL is an in-browser tool for writing, validating, and testing GraphQL queries.
executing specific queries and mutations to extract information or accomplish tasks
The Admin API lets you build apps and integrations that extend and enhance the Shopify admin.
